terms.comment: Queried by Morgan–Owens. Traupman 355 gives encombōma for overalls, but Lewis & Short defines it as a white garment worn by girls (Varr.).

terms.gloss: Traupman’s overalls; classically a girl’s white garment
terms.comment: Varro uses it of a white garment worn by girls (Varr. in Non. 543.1, Lewis & Short), from Greek ἐγκόμβωμα, an apron tied on.

sources: Lewis & Short: encomboma
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. overalls. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 355.
